verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a first-party Blob Storage Export feature for exporting large volumes on a schedule, which covers the core of bulk export to blob storage. The evidence is only a one-line overview listing, though, and does not specify what data is included. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that traces and datasets are covered by the export, documented native data-warehouse destinations, detail on formats and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
